stage1.impression: A warm, credible bar render with a good fluted counter front, nicely varied concrete on the right wall and a strong coloured shadow, but it still reads as CG: the pale floor is lit flat with crisp parallel shadows like daylight, the zinc counter glows white like marble, the Orbs are flat white discs, and the hoop globe reads as a light sculpture or a fairground decoration rather than thick cast acrylic. The altar speakers at the far end are small, dim white boxes and do not read as the hero. A magazine would see a handsome generic hospitality render made specific only by the globe; it would not run as a specific place yet.

blocking_9: The altar speakers read at a glance as tinted acrylic horns, with the speaker region lum_median >= 45 (now 32)
The floor sits below the counter and tables in brightness, with soft, overlapping pools instead of hard parallel stool shadows (floor lum_median now 65 against a frame median of 37)
Mother EARF reads as thick polished acrylic discs, all six tints glowing at their rims, not as thin blue and green hoops
The counter top reads as zinc (mid grey, soft uneven sheen), not as white stone
The Orbs show the smoke tint around a glowing liner instead of flat white discs
Visible signs of life in the foreground (a coat, a record, a half-drunk glass) and some visible air in the pendant light

defects.what: The floor is pale and evenly lit with crisp parallel stool shadows, which reads as daylight or a stage spot, not pools from pendants
The altar speakers read as small white boxes with a woofer behind glass; no tint, no horn and no glow through the acrylic; too dim to be the hero
Mother EARF: only the blue and green rims read; red, orange, yellow and violet are near invisible; the discs read as thin wire hoops, not 25 mm cast acrylic
The zinc counter top is near white (median 140, p95 238) and reads as polished marble
The Orbs are flat, uniform white discs (median 159, p95 227) with no visible tint or liner depth
The stools are identical copies in a regimented row; the backrest panels read as flat boards
The large panel on the right reads as a blank grey board or an unlit projection screen
A uniform added-looking grain and a slight orange cast over the whole frame, plus smeary denoised texture on the wood at 1:1
The fir beams are smooth and uniform, with no checks, nail holes or darker end grain

changes.problem: The altar pair, the room's reason to exist, is dim and reads as white boxes instead of the hero.

evidence.measured: lum_median 32.3, p95 170: only the woofer cone is lit; the cabinets around it sit near 20

change.to: 190 W, 2500 K, cone 22 deg, aimed at the upper third of each cabinet so the light passes through the smoked acrylic and the horn

changes.expected: The two speakers become the brightest vertical forms at the far end, their smoked tint and horn silhouette visible.

changes.problem: The Domes' downlights paint the floor as one bright plane with hard parallel shadows, which reads as daylight and pulls the eye away from the tables and the counter.

evidence.measured: floor lum_median 65.5 against a frame median of 37; crisp, parallel stool shadows across the whole aisle

change.setting: lamps: the Domes' downlights 4 x spot
change.to: 16 W, cone 28 deg, aimed at the counter top rather than the aisle

changes.expected: The aisle floor drops into shadow with soft-edged pools, the counter top becomes the lit surface.

changes.problem: The floor is too pale and too reflective for night concrete; it reads as grey tile.

evidence.measured: p95 182 on the floor; visible broad sheen pools

change.from: honed finish at the current tone
change.to: tone about 30 % darker and warmer, roughness raised so highlights spread; keep the mottle and stains

changes.expected: The floor reads as dark, warm, used concrete; the highlights on it are soft.

changes.problem: Mother EARF reads as two coloured hoops (blue, green); the warm discs and the acrylic's thickness are lost.

evidence.measured: lum_median 23.9, p95 73.6; red, orange, yellow and violet rims barely above the ceiling behind

change.to: 0.03, and move the hard spot so it rakes the disc faces (from [6.24, 2.75, 3.32] to about [5.4, 2.4, 3.3]) so the disc bodies catch light

changes.expected: All six rims glow in their tints and the discs read as solid, thick acrylic with lit faces, while the wall shadow stays.

changes.problem: The zinc counter reads as white marble.

change.to: darker blue-grey patina, roughness up to about 0.45, faint wipe marks and ring stains

changes.expected: The counter top reads as aged zinc catching the pendant pools, not as stone.

changes.problem: The Orbs read as flat white discs; the smoke tint and the frosted liner inside it do not show.
changes.expected: The liner glows inside a visibly smoked shell; the tables keep a warm pool.

changes.problem: The foreground has no sign of life, and the stools are a regimented row of identical copies.

evidence.measured: seen: eight identical stools in a straight line; no coat or record in the near third

change.from: coat over a counter chair out of view; seat offsets up to 7 deg, 2.5 cm
change.to: coat over the nearest stool back, a record and sleeve on the nearest table, a half-drunk glass on the counter in the near third; seat offsets up to 15 deg and 6 cm, one stool turned out toward the camera

changes.expected: The near third reads as lived-in; the row stops reading as a copy array.

changes.problem: Uniform grain and a slight orange cast over everything read as a filter, and the air is empty.

evidence.measured: ceiling r_median 63, g 33, b 17: strong orange; even grain in flat areas

change.to: white_balance_k 2800, haze 0.006, remove any added grain

changes.expected: Warm but not orange; faint cones below the Domes and the altar spots.

out_of_scope.request: Make the altar speakers read as tinted acrylic horns rather than white boxes with a woofer
out_of_scope.why: EARF's product (its shape, colour and parts) is fixed; only light can be changed, and c1 is that change

out_of_scope.request: Make Mother EARF's discs read as 25 mm thick and not as thin hoops
out_of_scope.why: The product's geometry and tints are fixed and owner-chosen; only its glow and the spot can change (c4)

out_of_scope.request: Give the stools a less generic design, and the fir beams checks and end grain
out_of_scope.why: The seats and the room's materials are part of the fixed room design; the beams' texture may be a material change the owner should approve

out_of_scope.request: Make the right-hand panels read as lit frosted screens rather than blank boards
out_of_scope.why: The screens and what they show are fixed; raising their emission (now 0.03) is allowed but should be judged after c2 to c8
